== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[K-3PO (Kay-Threepio) (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[K-3PO (Kay-Threepio) (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
